source_title: Amazon slashes $429 off the Samsung Galaxy S26 Plus 512GB
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
The Samsung Galaxy S26 Plus 512GB has dropped to $970 on Amazon, which is a big cut for a 2026 flagship phone. That’s $429 off the $1,399.99 recommended retail price, or 31% off RRP, and it’s a deal worth jumping on if you’ve been waiting for this model to fall under the $1,000 mark.
It has rarely been this cheap, and there’s another reason not to wait around. This price is only for the white colorway, so stock may not stick around for long once more shoppers spot it.
The Galaxy S26 Plus sits in the middle of Samsung’s 2026 flagship range, but it still brings a lot to the table. You’re getting 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, which is a strong setup for anyone who keeps lots of photos, videos, apps, and games on their phone. It also has a 6.7-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with QHD+ resolution, giving you a sharp and high-end screen for streaming, browsing, and everyday use.
Samsung launched this model in March 2026, and it’s built as a premium larger-screen option in the lineup. It also includes Galaxy AI features, strong battery life, and the polished flagship software experience Samsung is known for. For buyers who want extra local storage without stepping up to an Ultra model, this version makes a lot of sense.
It’s also backed by a 4.6-star Amazon rating, which adds even more confidence to the deal. You can check it out on Amazon while the white model is still discounted.
